notes_for_editor: Thin record. Neither the register nor the Forest Lookouts page gives a build year, staffing history, fire history, or access rules. The FDACS page describes the forest's wildfire history but does not mention the tower. The OpenStreetMap point for the tower was checked but is community-edited and not cited. One page read ran over the per-tower budget because the first grep pass was partial. The register prints the elevation as 133 ft (41 m); 133 ft is 40.5 m, and the story uses the register's printed figure. Verification 2026-10-08: the steel-tower description is now attributed to Forest Lookouts, which is the only source that says steel; 'northern Baker County' was corrected to Baker County in northern Florida; the advice to ask the Florida Forest Service and not to climb was removed because FDACS does not support it.
